fact: The Star column says KRA's iTax portal takes electronically submitted returns, with VAT returns filed on iTax from mid-August 2026 after moving off the offline Excel template.
KRA's public notice of 23 April 2026 says that from May 2026 validated export values from iCMS are prefilled in the VAT return in iTax, which taxpayers file there.

KRA's November/December 2025 release notes describe iTax handling taxpayer income tax returns, with returns validated against eTIMS invoices and customs import records, and a fix letting taxpayers amend monthly rental income returns.
The Kenya Revenue Authority says taxpayers can file returns through its WhatsApp-based tax filing service, powered by the Shuru AI chatbot.
KRA Commissioner General Humphrey Wattanga said a Kenyan can file returns through the USSD code *222*5# and KRA services are also on WhatsApp.
Business Daily reports taxpayers file annual income tax returns on iTax, the electronic tax system, which crashed at the 30 June 2025 deadline.
Techweez quotes the Treasury Cabinet Secretary saying the UHR payroll system has been linked to KRA iTax since July 2023 to facilitate filing of PAYE for employees and State Departments.
